title: Python: class decorators can replace the class: refuse unless every decorator is on a known non-replacing list (DEC-303 (a31) Q2)
description: DEC-303 (a31) Q2 (follows N3, GCLI-97): a decorator can replace the class, so a decorated class is refused (unresolved, in the bin it would have without the rule: receiver-needs-inference for E1, the name/run-time-bound bin for N3, the pre-rule bin for the constructor-bound case of 6d) for E1, the constructor-bound case of 6d and N3, unless every decorator on it is on a short known-non-replacing list. Each entry is an unshadowed import (from m import d, or import m with @m.d, bare or called) of a decorator documented to return the same class, pinned by a fixture. PROPOSED LIST for review: dataclasses.dataclass (bare and called; adds methods and returns the class, slots=True builds a new class with the same methods so in-repo resolution still names the right defs), functools.total_ordering, typing.final, typing.runtime_checkable, enum.unique. Excluded on purpose: any decorator not importable from the standard library, functools.wraps and cache-style function decorators, contextlib.contextmanager, attrs.define and any third-party decorator, and any shadowed or rebound name. Measure the recall cost on the five pins per site. Mutation-check each guard; negatives must reach the new branch.
implementationNotes: Built (DEC-303 (a31) Q2). ClassInfo.decoratorCallees records each class decorator's callee (the function of @d(...)); hasReplacingDecorator is false only when every decorator is a bare or called name bound by exactly one 'from m import d' (alias ok) or m.d with m bound by exactly one 'import m' (alias ok), and m.d is on NON_REPLACING_CLASS_DECORATORS = dataclasses.dataclass, functools.total_ordering, typing.final, typing.runtime_checkable, enum.unique (the proposed list, unchanged). Relative, function-local and star imports, rebound or doubly bound names, dotted decorators of two segments, call results and every other callee shape count as replacing. Applied in instanceClassOf (E1 and N3) and in knownClassOf's constructor-bound branch (rule 6d x = Cls(); x.m()); the annotated-receiver and import branches of 6d are NOT touched (an annotation names the type, not a construction). A refused site returns null so it stays in the bin it had without the rule. Fixtures (test/python-calls.test.ts 'class decorators'): 11 allowed forms x 3 site shapes, 16 refused forms x 3 site shapes, bin counts for a refused site, annotated receiver still resolves. Mutation checks, source restored each time (8 mutants, all red): always-false, always-true, bindings-length, kind check, module/name list lookup, segments-length, instanceClassOf call, 6d call. Two guards (dots, import name null) survived mutation because the kind check made them redundant, so they were removed rather than left unmeasured. PER-SITE MEASURE (instrumented worktrees at origin/dev fe83436 vs the branch calls.ts, five pins, multiset diff): flask, httpx, tqdm 0 changed. jinja 14 changed, all inRepo to receiver(needs-inference), tests/test_utils.py reaching LRUCache methods (class decorated @abc.MutableMapping.register). rich 21 changed, all inRepo to receiver(needs-inference): Layout (examples/fullscreen.py:24, examples/layout.py:20, rich/layout.py:414, tests/test_layout.py x9) and Style (tests/test_style.py x9), both decorated @rich_repr (an in-repo function). 35 sites lost in total, none gained; entry counts equal on all five; none is a precision gain I can show: both decorators return the same class, so these are recall cost of the ruling. NOT MEASURED: precision beyond reading the two decorators; decorators on a base class are not read (a subclass of a replaced class still resolves); GCLI-103 items not touched.

ROUND 1 FIX (Opus BLOCK at 393c959, DEC-303 (a32)). (1) hasReplacingDecorator now also requires imported.outcome === 'external': a repo-local dataclasses.py, typing.py, enum.py or functools.py resolves in-repo and no longer matches by module string; fixture: each of the four local files defining the decorator is refused at E1, N3 and 6d. (2) (a32) item 2: dataclass is on the list only in a form that keeps the original class, a bare decorator or a call whose slots keyword is absent or literally False; slots=True, slots=<variable>, a positional argument or a ** splat refuse. ClassInfo.decoratorSlots records absent, false or other per decorator (slotsSpelling); the check needs no dataclass name test, since no other listed decorator takes slots (a name test could not be told from its absence by any valid program, so I dropped it rather than leave an unmeasured guard). The fixture '@dc.dataclass(slots=True)' flipped from allowed to refused; new allowed: slots=False, slots=False among others, dataclass(), dataclass(frozen=True), dataclass(order=True) after final; new refused: slots=True, slots=True via alias, slots=<variable>, slots=True among others, ** splat, positional, final then slots=True dataclass. Mutation checks (restored): no slots guard, slots=False treated as other, positional ignored, outcome guard: each 1 red. Two other mutants (arguments-null branch, duplicate-slots-keyword last-wins) are equivalent on valid Python and were simplified away or left. Re-measure per site on the five pins at fe83436 vs the branch: identical to the first measure, 35 sites (jinja 14, rich 21), none gained, flask httpx tqdm 0; no slots dataclass appears among the changed sites. Full gates: typecheck, lint, format:check, bun test 815 pass, lore check --strict 0.14.1.
